about: The fewest passing titles scripts/loam-exit-check.mjs accepts for each exit row, by the place its row names, so an exclude, a skipped suite or a deleted file cannot pass unnoticed.

Each is the count a full run observed. When exit tests are added or removed on purpose, run the check on a run that has them with --print-minimums, and copy the counts it prints here in the same pull request, saying why each changed.
